meta.name: linkedin-cli
meta.description: A bird-like LinkedIn CLI for searching profiles, checking messages, and summarizing your feed using session cookies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在终端搜索LinkedIn人脉、查看消息和摘要动态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用LinkedIn但不想打开网页或App
copy.tagline_en: Search LinkedIn profiles, check messages, and summarize feed in terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LinkedIn often but prefer the terminal over browser or app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索 LinkedIn 个人资料、查看消息、总结动态，并显示你自己的资料信息。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索 LinkedIn 用户、查看消息或总结动态时触发。

say.text: 搜索 LinkedIn 上叫“张三”的人。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 查看我的最新 LinkedIn 消息。
say.note: Claude 会读取你的消息列表。

say.text: 总结我 LinkedIn 动态的前5条。
say.note: Claude 会获取并总结动态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search LinkedIn profiles, check messages, summarize your feed, and display your own profile details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search LinkedIn users, check messages, or summarize your feed.

say_en.text: Search LinkedIn for someone named 'John Doe'.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the search and return results.
Claude will read your message list.

say_en.text: Summarize the top 5 posts from my LinkedIn feed.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and summarize the feed.
